title: Valid Parenthesis String
summary: Replace every asterisk with an opening parenthesis, a closing parenthesis, or nothing.
statement: Replace every asterisk with an opening parenthesis, a closing parenthesis, or nothing. Decide whether any replacement balances the entire string without closing a parenthesis before it has opened.

examples.explanation: The last opening has nothing after it to close it.
The asterisk can act as an opening.

hints: Conceptual: Every prefix needs enough possible opening parentheses.
Directional: Track the smallest and largest number of unmatched openings a prefix could leave.
Implementation: Update both bounds for each character, floor the lower bound at zero, and reject any negative upper bound.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
